opportunities.name: Paper lookup: arXiv advanced search → Semantic Scholar citations → note
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic restricted to a specific year, open the top result, look it up on Semantic Scholar for author/citations, then save a summary note.
steps: Type topic in search term box
Tick date filter checkbox, choose specific year, enter YYYY
Click Search and open the top result
Go to Semantic Scholar and search the paper title
Open the paper to read first author and citation count
Open notes, create new note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Case law lookup: CourtListener → Cornell LII statute → note
opportunities.description: Search a Supreme Court case on CourtListener, open it, look up the related US Code section on Cornell LII, and save a note with citation, decision date and statute.
steps: Search case name in CourtListener keyword box and press Enter
Go to Cornell LII, search the statute citation, open the section
Open notes, add a note '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)' and press Enter

opportunities.description: Set activity and location on Peerspace and run the search.
steps: Click activity combobox, select all, type/select activity
Click location combobox, select all, type city and choose suggestion
